أندمر (form VII)
# أَنْدَمِرُ (ʔandamiru) /ʔan.da.mi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْدَمَرَ (indamara)
# أَنْدَمِرَ (ʔandamira) /ʔan.da.mi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْدَمَرَ (indamara)
# أَنْدَمِرْ (ʔandamir) /ʔan.da.mir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْدَمَرَ (indamara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
